title: NAFIS Unemployment Benefits: Eligibility, Application & FAQs
description: Learn about NAFIS unemployment benefits in the UAE. Check eligibility, application process, and FAQs to access financial support during job loss

contentHtml:
The UAE government is constantly making efforts to upgrade Emiratis in terms of skills and improve their earning patterns, so that they can live a better life. It’s a win-win situation where not only nationals can get benefits, but employers also have a chance to gain the trust of the government and earn various incentives. Similarly, the entire economy can benefit with a single arrow.

NAFIS is another initiative introduced by the government of the UAE to increase the exposure of Emiratis in the private sector. The program not only supports UAE nationals when they’re employed, but they can also get assistance when they are in dire need of financial i.e., jobless.

In this blog post, you’ll gain insights into NAFIS unemployment benefits that you are granted by the UAE when you’re unemployed.

Get to know every detail of NAFIS unemployment benefits closely by not skipping any part!

Overview of NAFIS Unemployment Benefits

NAFIS is a federal program launched by the UAE government under the “Projects of the 50” initiative to increase Emirati participation in the private sector. It offers financial support, training programs, career development, and unemployment benefits to UAE nationals. The goal of NAFIS is to empower Emiratis with skills, connect them to private-sector jobs, and create a sustainable, competitive workforce that aligns with the UAE’s long-term economic vision.

NAFIS Unemployment Benefits support Emirati citizens in the UAE who lose their jobs by providing temporary financial assistance. The program helps ease the transition period until individuals secure new employment. It encourages active job searching through career guidance and training opportunities. The benefits are structured with clear eligibility criteria set by the UAE government. Overall, NAFIS ensures social stability while empowering Emiratis to rejoin the workforce confidently.

What Are NAFIS Unemployment Benefits?

NAFIS Unemployment Benefits provide Emirati citizens who lose their private-sector jobs involuntarily with financial support for up to 6 consecutive months or 12 months spread over five years. Monthly support includes:

  • AED 7,000 for the unemployed Emirati
  • AED 4,500 for a non-working spouse
  • AED 2,400 per child for the first two children
  • AED 1,600 for the third child

Authority Responsible for NAFIS Unemployment Initiative:

ETCC, Emirati Talent Competitiveness Council, particularly through the NAFIS Program, administers unemployment support under the government of the UAE, Projects of the 50 initiative. The program is designed to make sure that Emiratis receive income security while they seek new jobs.

After understanding what NAFIS unemployment benefits are and how they work, we are now moving towards the NAFIS unemployment eligibility criteria to get quick approval.

Criteria for NAFIS Unemployment Benefits:

In this section, we’ll share the criteria for NAFIS unemployment benefits. So, if you’re a UAE national and currently unemployed, you must check whether you meet the criteria specified by the UAE government or not.

Eligibility Requirements:

Those who want to apply for the unemployment scheme must be UAE nationals aged 18–60. He/she must have lost their job involuntarily, not by resignation or misconduct. The applicants are not students or beneficiaries of other social support programs. It is a requirement to be registered on the NAFIS platform through UAE Pass.

Requirements Based on Employment Status:

  • Employed previously in the private sector
  • The job loss must have been beyond the person’s control (e.g., company downsizing)
  • Family income from other sources (e.g., rentals or businesses) may affect eligibility

Income and Work History Requirements for Eligibility

  • NAFIS reviews the applicant’s income from work, real estate, or commercial licenses to determine eligibility
  • Applicants must actively seek new employment and cannot refuse job offers without risking disqualification

How to Apply for NAFIS Unemployment Benefits:

The process to apply for NAFIS’s support is simple and clear. The following are the documents required and steps involved to apply today:

Required Documents for the Application:

Importantly, you need documents including an Emirates ID copy, proof of job termination like a termination letter or an employer statement, a national service completion/exemption certificate if needed, and bank account details for payment disbursement.

Step-by-Step Process for Applying for NAFIS Unemployment Benefit:

  1. Log in to the NAFIS portal via UAE Pass or gov.ae
  2. Complete your profile with employment history and job loss details
  3. Navigate to the unemployment benefits section and start your application
  4. Upload required documents
  5. Submit and await review

Online Application vs. In-Person Application:

The online application is fast, convenient, and accessible anytime via UAE Pass. In-person is, however, used for guidance or assistance if you face technical issues online.

Processing Time for Application & Expectation:

The processing time for the NAFIS benefit application for unemployed individuals has been discussed in the section:

Time to Process:

Mostly, processing takes a few weeks. It depends, however, on document completeness and system workload. For instance, approvals are communicated via the NAFIS portal, SMS, or email.

Delays in the Application Process:

Often, delays occur due to missing or unclear documents. It also sometimes takes time due to incomplete profiles or discrepancies in submitted data. It is advisable to always double-check your inputs before submitting.

How to Track Your Application Status:

To track your application status, you can log in to your NAFIS account online, where the “My Applications” section shows status updates from submission to approval or request for more info.

Moreover, as discussed earlier in the blog about the eligibility criteria and the NAFIS unemployment application process. Let’s we are heading towards how much financial aid you’ll get under the NAFIS program.

Payment Information:

In this section, you’ll explore the amount you may receive when you’re unemployed as an Emirati under the NAFIS unemployment benefits:

How Much Can You Receive?

The amount you are granted under the program is presented in a tabular form:

Beneficiary Monthly Amount (AED)
Unemployed Emirati 7,000
Non-working spouse 4,500
Child – 1st & 2nd 2,400 each
Child – 3rd 1,600

Important Note:

Each benefit is available for up to 6 consecutive months, with a total of 12 months allowance across 5 years.

Payment Methods and Frequency:

Usually, payments happen monthly, via a registered bank account. This assures timely support through the NAFIS system.

What to Do If You Don’t Receive Your Payment:

Didn’t receive your payment? You may check the status in your NAFIS portal. Secondly, contact support via the platform or helpline and confirm your bank details and documentation accuracy.

Impact of NAFIS Unemployment Benefits on Your Taxes:

In this blog section, we’ll discuss whether the amount is taxable or not that is received under the NAFIS unemployment benefit program:

Receiving Nafis Benefits may have tax implications, as the amount could be considered taxable income depending on UAE regulations. Always review your tax obligations before filing.

Are NAFIS Unemployment Benefits Taxable?

NAFIS benefits are government grants, and the UAE does not tax personal income. These benefits are tax-free.

How to Report NAFIS Unemployment Benefits on Your Tax Return?

You don’t need to report them; they don’t appear in tax filings.

Can You Withhold Taxes from Your NAFIS Unemployment Benefits?

No taxes apply, so there’s nothing to withhold.

Benefits for Special Circumstances:

The part-time workers, as well as freelancers, also have a chance to try their luck with the NAFIS unemployment initiative. All you need to meet the general criteria that are mandatory for you to qualify.

NAFIS Benefits for Part-Time Workers and Freelancers:

If you’re classified as part-time or on a freelance contract but previously worked in the private sector and lost your job involuntarily, you may still qualify if you meet general eligibility. Contact support to confirm.

Impact of Voluntary Resignation on NAFIS Unemployment Eligibility:

Resigning voluntarily disqualifies you. Only involuntary terminations (like layoffs or downsizing) make you eligible.

Can You Claim NAFIS Unemployment Benefits if You Are Self-Employed?

Generally, self-employed individuals don’t qualify, since you’re not unemployed per program definitions.

Recent Changes to NAFIS Unemployment Benefits:

In this blog section, we’ll uncover the recent changes that have occurred in the unemployment benefit program by NAFIS.

New Reforms and Regulations:

In 2025, NAFIS reemphasized flexibility. The unemployment benefit remains capped at 6 consecutive months or 12 months within five years, enhancing support while encouraging re-entry into the workforce.

Recent Economic Changes:

Economic shifts, like inflation or job market tightness, reinforce the value of this safety net. NAFIS assures Emiratis don’t fall into hardship while they seek new employment.

Important Resources for Applicants:

Different sources are available for applicants like you to obtain information about the benefits of the NAFIS unemployment scheme.

Official NAFIS Unemployment Benefits Website:

You can use the nafis.gov.ae portal (or gov.ae) for application, documentation, and updates.

NAFIS Support Centers and Contact Information:

To access help, do so via online chat, call centers, or government service centers like Tasheel or Amer Centers.

Additional Government Assistance Programs:

Also, you can explore NAFIS’s other streams, like training grants, child allowance, and salary support, through the same portal.

Now, summarizing the NAFIS unemployment benefit scheme for your better understanding, consisting of all the topics discussed in this blog post.

Final Words 

For Emiratis like you, NAFIS Unemployment Benefits is a vital safety net. Giving them speedy financial relief, job transition support, and family assistance at the time of distress. You can walk through the process smoothly by understanding eligibility, application steps, and support limits. Get the benefit out of the program by registering on the NAFIS portal today, stay informed, and gain most of this important government protection.

Emiratisation Gateway support is nearby you if you require quick assistance. Their team is one of the best that understands about NAFIS program well and gives you great advice on how to claim your rights as a job seeker, employed Emirati, or unemployed Emirati.

FAQs

Who is eligible for NAFIS Unemployment Benefits?

Unemployed Emirati citizens actively seeking jobs and registered under the NAFIS program are eligible.

How much financial support does NAFIS provide?

Eligible individuals can receive up to AED 7,000 monthly, depending on their profile and circumstances.

How can I apply for NAFIS unemployment benefits?

You can apply online via the official NAFIS portal by registering and submitting required documents.

Can employed Emiratis apply for these benefits?

No, the program is only for unemployed Emiratis seeking work opportunities.

How long can I receive NAFIS support?

Support is provided temporarily until the individual secures suitable employment.
